conversationUnavailable: The conversation is unavailable. Check the coordinator configuration and try again.
coordinatedTasksHint: The latest 100 tasks owned by this orchestrator. Open a task to manage its agent, workflow and execution.
coordinatorHint: Chat with the Orchestrator while workspace task state stays beside it.
deleteOrchestratorHint: Remove this coordinator and stop its sessions. Delivery tasks remain on the board.
knownTaskTotals: Loaded tasks: {{open}} open pull requests (known for {{prKnown}}/{{tasks}}); {{files}} changed files (known for {{gitKnown}}/{{tasks}}).
name: Name
noCoordinatedTasks: No tasks yet. Open the conversation to delegate work or ask the orchestrator to adopt an existing task.
noLoadedMatches: No matches in the loaded tasks. More pages may contain matches.
noOrchestrators: No orchestrators yet. Add one to coordinate this workspace.
orchestrationEnable: Enable the experimental feature in System settings.
orchestratorProfileHint: This profile runs the coordinator. Delivery tasks use their own profiles, which you can change independently.
orchestratorsHint: Add a global role to this workspace, choose the agent that runs it and provide workspace context. Each assignment has its own conversation and tasks.
partialCoverage: Counts describe loaded tasks. Load more to include remaining matches.
personaExecutorProfileHint: Pin this persona to a configured local or SSH profile. Worker profiles choose where their account and tools run.
profileUnavailable: The selected agent profile or execution environment is unavailable. Update this coordinator’s configuration to continue.
roleAssignmentHint: Name, icon and instructions come from the global role. Role changes apply to every workspace using it on the next turn.
rolesHint: Configure each role once: its name, icon and instructions. Workspaces choose the agent profile, execution environment and local context. Saved role changes apply to all assignments on their next turn.
selectCoordinatorHint: Choose a coordinator to open its conversation.
selectionUnavailable: That coordinator is unavailable in this workspace. Choose an assignment or check its configuration.
staleTasks: Task data may be out of date. Refresh to try again.
workspaceUnavailable: This workspace could not be loaded. Check your access and try again.
displayNameHint: The name this orchestrator uses in chat, navigation and settings. Leave it empty to use the role name ({{role}}).
askBeforeCreateHint: When on, the orchestrator proposes each new task in chat and waits for you to approve, edit or dismiss it. When off, it creates and starts tasks on its own.
autoCommentSource: Comment on the source issue automatically
autoCommentSourceHint: When a delegated task created from a Jira or Linear issue reaches review or completes, Kandev posts a short comment on that issue once per change.
autoMoveSourceDone: Move the source issue to done automatically
autoMoveSourceDoneHint: When a delegated task created from a Jira or Linear issue completes, Kandev also moves the issue to its done status. Leave this off if your team closes issues itself.
singleOrchestratorHint: A workspace has one orchestrator. Open it to rename it, change its role or adjust its behavior.
orchestratorExists: This workspace already has an orchestrator, so it was opened instead.
legacyMultipleOrchestrators: This workspace has more than one orchestrator from an earlier version. They keep working, but a workspace now has one. Delete the ones you no longer need.
